title: One incident, several reporting clocks
story: An emulated management-plane breach simultaneously affects telecom backhaul and electrical power grid communications across independent operators.
human_decisions: Commander aligns incident response timeline to earliest reporting deadline.
Commander approves PB-10 notification to electricity grid coordination center.
Commander authorizes PB-06 failover over domestic backup.

objective.what: Guindy site CHN-04 isolates compromised management segment and restores grid telemetry on verified domestic backup.
proof: grid telemetry restored on clean link

schedule.what: M1 detects anomalous management API queries across shared infrastructure.
Satellite operator detects unauthorized configuration read on Guindy gateway link.
M3 attributes activity to coordinated management-plane intrusion.
Power utility identifies loss of remote supervisory control telemetry.
Mobile operator observes degradation of emergency and grid communications.
CERT-In agent maps disparate statutory incident reporting deadlines across affected sectors.
Gap Analyst audits binding cross-sector space cyber baselines.
Gap Analyst audits downstream warning requirements across interconnected critical sectors.
Commander approves PB-01 account containment and PB-10 notification to state grid authorities.
Mobile operator fails over site CHN-04 to verified domestic backup path.
M1 confirms recovery of grid telemetry and emergency communications.
